Nina: Quick FYI — noticed a pattern where anchors in the KB were lowercased/normalized during the migration and a bunch of internal links in runbooks are 404ing. e.g. `/kb/runtime#Page-123` -> `/kb/runtime#page-123`

Alex: Can you paste a concrete example so I can repro?

Nina: Sure — here's one I hit in the runtime runbook:
`/kb/runtime#Page-123`

I tested a simple sed that should fix most anchors in-place:
```
sed -E -i '' 's/href=\"([^\"]+)\"/href=\"$(echo \\\\1 | tr '\\'[:upper:]\\' '\\'[:lower:]\\' | sed -E \"s/[ _]+/-/g\")\"/g' $(rg -l \"href=\\\"#\" ./content)
```
It's a quick hack but will lowercase and turn spaces/underscores into `-`.

Sam: I can take a small PR to run that against Markdown files + a smoke link-check job. @DocsBot can you queue a staging link-check after the PR merges? :thumbsup:

DocsBot: link-checker: scheduled — will run on the `staging` site after the referenced PR merges. Report in ~5m.

Jorge: If Sam is owning the PR, can we also rotate ownership? the original KB owner for runtime left last quarter. @Priya could you be the reviewer/maintainer for that section?

Priya: Yep I can review. Please add me to CODEOWNERS for `/kb/runtime/**` and ping me in the PR.

Alex: Optional: rather than only lowercasing maybe normalize anchors to kebab-case (lower + hyphens). That avoids mixing `page_123` vs `Page 123`.

Nina: Agreed — PR coming that normalizes to kebab-case and includes a small unit/CI smoke check. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2120

Sam: I'll add a changelog note and run the post-merge link-check. ETA EOD today. Thanks all! :rocket:
